# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet for substitute teachers."""

from typing import Iterable

from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError


# ---
def contact_rows(students: Iterable) -> list:
    """Text rows of name, section and email, sorted by name."""
    ordered = sorted(students, key=lambda item: item.display_name)
    if not ordered:
        raise ProjectError("no students to list")
    for student in ordered:
        if not student.email:
            raise ProjectError(
                f"no email for {student.display_name}"
            )
    name_width = 0
    sect_width = 0
    for student in ordered:
        name_width = max(name_width, len(student.display_name))
        sect_width = max(sect_width, len(student.section))
    rows = []
    for student in ordered:
        name = student.display_name
        rows.append(
            f"{name:<{name_width}}  "
            f"{student.section:<{sect_width}}  {student.email}"
        )
    return rows
# end of file
EOF
cat > tests/test_contacts.py <<'EOF'
# owner: platform
import unittest

from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Student


def make_student(last, first, section, email):
    return Student("1", last, first, section, email)


class ContactTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rows_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        """Rows are sorted by name with aligned columns."""
        rows = contact_rows([
            make_student("Thistle", "Bram", "B", "b@x.org"),
            make_student("Ash", "Cy", "A", "c@x.org"),
        ])
        self.assertTrue(rows[0] == "Ash, Cy       A  c@x.org")
        self.assertTrue(rows[1] == "Thistle, Bram  B  b@x.org")

    def test_missing_email_names_student(self):
        """A student without an email raises naming them."""
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError) as caught:
            contact_rows([make_student("Ash", "Cy", "A", None)])
        self.assertTrue("Ash, Cy" in str(caught.exception))

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        """An empty list raises."""
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            contact_rows([])
# end of file
EOF
